ostinato-dawn.hears: The 5/4 ostinato tapping out of silence (col legno strings, harp, timpani on G) before the transcriber hears anything: the hole filler for the opening.
ostinato-dawn.rule: audio onsets 7.1-20.6 s, >= -40 dB, 90 ms apart, as G2

ostinato-opening.hears: The ostinato through the whole first statement, pp to f: the steady 5/4 tapping on G (the transcribed G3/G2 strokes, Ab1 at 37 s, Bb2/Ab2 at 51-57 s), with the audio filling 7.1-20.6 s and 38-48 s.
ostinato-opening.rule: roll notes <= G3 shorter than 0.45 s, lowest of each cluster, 20.6-62.6 s; audio onsets (as G2) in the seconds the roll has none, 7.1-62.6 s

theme-creep.hears: The creeping theme above the ostinato (bassoons and horns, then the brass): the long held tones that rub against the G, the Db and Ab first (15.5-19 s), then B, Db, F, Bb, A ... as long notes. The D4/B4/D5 partials of the ostinato G are left out.
theme-creep.rule: held CQT tones 8.5-48.6 s, not pitch class G nor the ostinato G2 partials D4, B4, D5 (62, 71, 74), Eb3-C6, >= -37 dB mean, the 2 loudest per started second, >= 0.6 s

theme-swell.hears: The theme climbing to its first forte: the held chord-tops of the brass and strings (C#4-E4-A4, Bb4, the E5/E6 chord at 54 s, Ab4, C5, Bb4, Eb4 to the B chord at 62.0 s).
theme-swell.rule: voiced-out line (held >= 0.28 s, loudest of its chord) of roll notes >= E3, 48.6-62.6 s, with pack.notes added where no roll note of that pitch starts within 50 ms

brass-swell-65.hears: Out of the dip after the B chord (-24 dB at 64.4 s): a brass swell, F3 with Ab4 rising to -8 dB at 65.7 s, then B4 held. The roll has nothing from 62.6 to 67.7 s.
brass-swell-65.rule: held CQT tones 62.6-68 s, >= -24 dB mean, Eb3 and up, not pitch class G, the 2 loudest per started second

brass-chords-1.hears: The brass chords that stack up over the ostinato into the first climax: Ab/Eb chords (58-60 s), the hammered B chord (61.8-62.3 s), the B and C# chords high up (69.6-75 s), Eb5 (76-77 s), F#5/F#6 (78-80 s), Ab5 at the peak (82 s).
brass-chords-1.rule: roll clusters 57.4-83.5 s with >= 3 pitches and loudest >= 65; of each, the lowest and highest note

cello-ostinato-2.hears: The ostinato carried on in the cellos under the crescendo (G3/F3 rocking, then Ab2), the machine under the brass.
cello-ostinato-2.rule: cello and strings notes <= G3 shorter than 0.45 s, lowest of each cluster, 62.6-83.5 s

climax-1.hears: The first climax held fff (0 dB): the grinding sustained tones as long notes, for a field or a slow widget to swell with.
climax-1.rule: held CQT tones 80.8-83.5 s, >= -20 dB mean, the 3 loudest per second; anchored (a tone starts only at an onset, a 3 dB rise or 80.8 s)

chord-hammer.hears: Hammered chord blocks (transcribed as plucked): the Db-major chord struck in quavers at 84-88 s, and again at 100-106 s. Machine-like, even.
chord-hammer.rule: plucked-lane clusters 83.5-131.6 s with >= 3 pitches; of each, the lowest and highest note

high-blasts.hears: The high blasts of the tutti over the C pedal: the C6 chords struck again and again (84-113 s), C#6/Eb6 (101-106 s), the A5 and Eb6 strokes, up to the blow at 131 s.
high-blasts.rule: roll clusters 83.5-131.6 s with >= 3 notes, top >= C5, loudest >= 85; the top note

pedal-bass.hears: The bass of the episode: the C pedal in the cellos (C2/C3), sliding to C# and back, repeated C3 strokes (88-90 s).
pedal-bass.rule: roll notes <= D3 (50), lowest of each cluster, 83.5-131.6 s

episode-line.hears: The inner line of the episode under the high blasts: the brass and string tune between the C pedal and the C6 chords.
episode-line.rule: voiced-out line, roll notes E3-B5 (52-83), 83.5-131.6 s

strike-131.hears: The blow that ends the episode (131.1-131.5 s, -1 dB, E5/Eb5/Bb5 chords), right before the drop to -13 dB.

ostinato-second.hears: The ostinato underneath the second subject (F#2-B2, the cellos), quieter.
ostinato-second.rule: roll notes <= G3 shorter than 0.45 s, lowest of each cluster, 131.6-164.9 s

unison-calls.hears: The second subject: unison calls high in the strings and winds (Bb5 repeated 133-135 s, Bb4, F4, Eb4, B4 ... then Ab5, B5, C6, G6 up to 160 s).
unison-calls.rule: voiced-out line, roll notes >= F4 (65), 131.6-164.9 s

high-repeats.hears: No bass at all: one high pitch struck again and again in even beats (C5, Eb5, E5), then F6 and F#6 alternating, C6, Ab4, E5, C6, stepping up: the build to the general pause.
high-repeats.rule: the top note of every roll cluster >= C4 (60), 164.9-185.6 s

ff-blow-186.hears: After the general pause (185.6-186.4 s, -39 dB): the ff Eb-major chord (Eb2 to G4, held 2 s), then a low rumble A1-D2 (188.4-189 s).
ff-blow-186.rule: pack notes 186.4-189.5 s held >= 1 s (the Eb chord), and the lowest of each cluster below D2 (the low run)

dying-throb.hears: The throb that dies away after the blow: E3 pulses with C3, slower and softer (v60 to v13), then a held E3 for 4 s: almost silence.

tuba-theme.hears: The tenor-tuba theme, low and slow (G1-A2, then up by steps to Eb3/F3), only in the piano model's notes; the roll has nothing here. Its every note.
tuba-theme.rule: pack notes <= A3 (57), 197.2-215 s, the lowest of each cluster, held >= 0.09 s; a repeat of a pitch within 0.15 s merged

trumpet-calls.hears: The calls in rising pairs above the slow march (C#5-C5, D5-Eb5, E5-F5-F#5 ..., then Ab5-A5, B5-D6), climbing into the return.
trumpet-calls.rule: voiced-out line, roll notes >= C5 (72), 212.8-256.6 s

middle-bass.hears: The slow bass under the calls (D3, F#3, E3 strokes; B1-C2 later).
middle-bass.rule: roll notes <= D3 (50), lowest of each cluster, 212.8-256.6 s

middle-chords.hears: The chords thickening at the end of the build (245-253 s), just before the return.
middle-chords.rule: roll clusters 240-256.6 s with >= 4 pitches; of each, the lowest and highest note

ostinato-tutti.hears: The whole orchestra hammering the 5/4 rhythm on G (G5 and G4 strokes): the opening ostinato come back at full force, every stroke.
ostinato-tutti.rule: roll cluster tops of pitch class G at G4-G5 (67, 79), 256.6-303.9 s

recap-blocks.hears: The chord blocks hammered in the ostinato's rhythm (transcribed as plucked: A-major with G at 268-270 s, Ab-major at 270-272 s, G chords at 272-274 s, the C minor wall at 293 s).
recap-blocks.rule: plucked-lane clusters 256.6-303.9 s with >= 3 pitches; of each, the lowest and highest note

recap-bass.hears: The bass of the return: G2/G3 strokes with F3, Eb3, Ab2 against them.
recap-bass.rule: roll notes <= G3 (55), lowest of each cluster, 256.6-303.9 s

brass-tenor-line.hears: A tenor line in the low brass (the transcriber filed it under voice: there is no choir in Mars) that slides between F3, G3 and E3 against the hammered G (284-296 s), and points later.

canon-theme.hears: The theme in the middle register over the continuing ostinato, quieter (-11 dB): Ab4, G4, Bb4, C5, Eb4 ... answering itself.
canon-theme.rule: voiced-out line, roll notes Bb3-B5 (58-83), 303.9-343.6 s

ostinato-canon.hears: The ostinato strokes in the bass under the canon (G2/G3, Ab2, Eb3).
ostinato-canon.rule: roll notes <= G3 shorter than 0.45 s, lowest of each cluster, 303.9-343.6 s

canon-blocks.hears: The chord strokes in the canon (transcribed as plucked).
canon-blocks.rule: plucked-lane clusters 303.9-343.6 s with >= 2 pitches; the top note

final-build.hears: The last build: C3 pedal strokes, Bb4 hammered (348 s), then the F3/G3 rocking under high G5/C#6 cries (351-357 s), to the pile-up.
final-build.rule: roll clusters 343.6-358.9 s with loudest >= 75; the top note

climax-pileup.hears: The most dissonant pile-up of the piece, held (-3 dB) over the organ: C3/C#3 with Ab3, Eb3, G2 grinding. Nothing is transcribed here; these are long notes from the audio, no re-attacks.
climax-pileup.rule: held CQT tones 358.9-367 s, >= -24 dB mean, the 3 loudest per second; anchored (a tone starts only at an onset, a 3 dB rise or 358.9 s)

aftermath-held.hears: The aftermath: grinding held chords that fall from -9 to -27 dB (F2, the C2/C3 pedal, G4, Ab4, Db), then the pp hush with Db and Eb high. Almost nothing transcribed: long notes from the audio.
aftermath-held.rule: held CQT tones 367-392.6 s, >= -32 dB mean, the 2 loudest per second; anchored (a tone starts only at an onset, a 3 dB rise or 367 s)

hush-rise.hears: Out of the hush: B4/F#4 figures, then A4-C5-Eb5 and G2 throbs, the rising scale Ab4-Bb4-C5-D5-Eb5-G5 at 393.2-394.3 s (to -2 dB).
hush-rise.rule: every roll cluster 386.5-395 s; the top note

pesante-g.hears: Between the first blows, G hammered in the top and the middle (G5 at ~0.2 s, G3): the ostinato's note, pesante.

final-blows.hears: The hammer blows of the end: 396.5, 399.15, 401.33, then each out of silence 405.3, 409.6, 412.7 and the last 415.75, held to the cut. The real ff blows.
final-blows.rule: audio onsets 396.4-415.8 s with strength >= 8 (the 7 hammer blows); each a C3+G2+G4 chord (the CQT peaks), held until the sound falls 15 dB (the last to the cut at 421.8 s)

blow-echoes.hears: The second, weaker strokes after the blows (400.15, 406.6, 411.0 s): each blow answered once.
blow-echoes.rule: audio onsets 396.4-415.7 s with strength 4.4-8 and >= -10 dB, as C3

last-chord.hears: The last chord, held ff to its cut at 421.8 s: one attack, six seconds of sound.
last-chord.rule: the pitches whose held CQT tones (>= -25 dB mean) cover >= 30 % of 415.75-421.8 s, one note each from the blow to the cut

ff-blows.hears: Every real ff blow out of silence or onto a cut: the Eb chord after the general pause and the seven hammer blows of the end. For fireworks.
ff-blows.rule: the Eb chord at 186.43 s (pack, its lowest and highest note) and the 7 final hammer blows (audio, C3 and G4)

bassline.hears: The lowest notes the lanes hear, the whole piece: the low ostinato, the C pedal, the bass of the return (sparse in the opening and the end).
bassline.rule: roll notes <= G2 (43), lowest of each cluster, the whole piece

violin-line.hears: The violins' held line (the lane's loudest held note per attack), the whole piece.
violin-line.rule: voiced-out line of the violin lane, the whole piece

viola-line.hears: The violas' held line, the whole piece (often the theme's middle voice).
viola-line.rule: voiced-out line of the viola lane, the whole piece

cello-line.hears: The cellos, the whole piece: the ostinato strokes and the bass of the tutti.
cello-line.rule: cello lane, lowest of each cluster, the whole piece

plucked-blocks.hears: Everything the transcriber filed as plucked (harp and hard-struck chord blocks): the hammered chords of 84-88, 100-106, 268-296 and 304-336 s.
plucked-blocks.rule: plucked lane, the top note of each cluster, the whole piece

strings-section.hears: The undivided string section: the ostinato strokes at the opening, the repeated blocks of the episodes.
strings-section.rule: strings lane (string sound the transcriber could not split), the top note of each cluster

hammered-repeats.hears: Every place one pitch is hammered again and again (the C6 blasts, the B4 strokes, the high repeats before the pause, the G5 of the return, the final G): the machine.
hammered-repeats.rule: repeated pitches (>= 3 strokes <= 0.45 s apart) among roll cluster tops, the whole piece

hole-38-48.hears: The ostinato where the roll is empty in the opening (38.9-48.6 s), to keep an ostinato widget alive.
hole-38-48.rule: audio onsets 38.9-48.6 s, >= -36 dB, as G2

hole-middle.hears: The slow middle's held sound (the low pedal and the tuba's notes) as long notes, for a field-like widget: the roll has nothing from 190 to 212 s.
hole-middle.rule: held CQT tones 189.5-212.8 s, >= -34 dB mean, the 2 loudest per second; anchored (a tone starts only at an onset, a 3 dB rise or 189.5 s)
